title.narrative: Partnership Coordination Facility Project for Somalia

description.narrative: Overall Objective:To contribute to the effective implementation of the NDP/CAS and the Resilience and Recovery Framework through the provision of ad hoc, targeted and complementary support; Specific Objectives: 1) mobilize advice, expertise and operational/organizational resources for the relevant PWGs/CAS Strands, and associated Ministries and Institutions; both at federal and state level; at Federal level;2) assists the Member State level to respond to specific and emerging needs in the framework of the work plan and milestones set up by each PWGs/CAS Strand or other relevant coordination and policy structures ; 3)enhance capacities for the implementation and monitoring of a national resilience strategy;4)support the work on the inclusive politics agenda including security and justice, federalization, process, the constitutional architecture and democratization through elections
